title: Divider
description: A thin line that separates content, horizontally or vertically, optionally with text.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A horizontal divider between two blocks of content.

with-text.title: With text
with-text.description: Children are rendered inside the line; textAlign places them left, center or right.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: Use orientation="vertical" with a length to separate inline items.

custom-style.title: Custom style
custom-style.description: Set the line color with the --divider-color CSS custom property (inline style, class or ancestor), and customize thickness, length, spacing and the elevation shadow.

flex-item.title: In a flex container
flex-item.description: flexItem makes a vertical divider stretch to the height of its flex container.

DividerProps.length: Length of the line (width when horizontal, height when vertical)
DividerProps.spacing: Margin around the divider in pixels (top/bottom when horizontal, left/right when vertical)
DividerProps.children: Optional text rendered inside a horizontal divider
DividerProps.flexItem: Stretches a vertical divider to the height of its flex container

cssVars.--divider-spacing: Inline margin around a vertical divider
cssVars.--divider-text-gap: Space between the text and the lines

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Without content the divider renders a native <hr>; text in the default slot sits between the two halves of the line.

variants.title: Styles and options
variants.description: variant (solid, dashed, dotted), thickness, spacing, length, elevation and text-align for the text.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: Vertical dividers are inline and 1em high; flex-item stretches one to the height of its flex container.

slots.default: Optional text of a horizontal divider (ignored when vertical).
